description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Physical Mutation

Your physiology changes, hips and legs bending, so that you move about on all fours like an animal with your eyes and nose close to the ground. Your skin darkens to a dark grey or black tone to better camouflage you. You can’t hold any items while moving, unless you have more than two arms, and you have a -20 modifier with armed fighting due to your awkward position. You gain the Dark Vision mutation, the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.Z91GFaT6FhEwyESU]{Tunnel Rat} and @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.MGEPI4jNhymNIRVz]{Scale Sheer Surfaces} Talents. You can’t gain this mutation if you already have the Centauroid mutation. You can only gain this mutation once.
